title: unified-rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow rollback enhancements and observability
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: improve safety and observability for mixed-mode rollouts (canary + A/B + shadow) and harden automated rollback workflows when multi-metric thresholds or transient spikes are observed. This PR consolidates changes across the rollout controller, metrics matcher, and observability pipelines to reduce false positives for rollbacks and provide clearer signals for operators.

Summary of changes: 1) Extend the rollout policy DSL to support per-strategy metric windows and dampening (e.g., longer windows for shadow traffic and shorter for canary), 2) Add composite metric support (weighted combination of latency/error/quality regressions) used by the autorollback evaluator, 3) Implement stability guards to prevent oscillating rollbacks during short-lived infra noise, 4) Improve observability: new rollout-level Prometheus metrics, structured traces for rollout decision paths, and dashboard templates for the Console, 5) Add e2e and integration tests that validate rollback behavior under synthetic traffic patterns and flaky path simulation, 6) Backwards-compatible behavior checks and migration notes for existing rollout configs.

Why this change: we observed two incidents (Linked Linear: ENG-9876) where aggressive metric windows caused unnecessary full rollbacks in the presence of transient regional CPU pressure. Operators requested finer control for shadow traffic evaluation and clearer evidence in tracing to debug rollback decisions. This PR implements both control-plane and telemetry improvements to address those gaps.

Risk and compatibility: rollout DSL changes are additive; existing policies remain valid. Default behaviour unchanged. There is a small change to the serialized rollout status (adds rollout_decision_trace field) which is backwards-compatible for clients that ignore unknown fields. No breaking API changes.

Rollout plan: landed behind feature flag rollout.autorollback.enhanced (disabled by default). We will enable in staging for 48h then enable in canary region, monitor composite_rollback_score and rollback_count (Console). Auto-enabling in production will be gated by 72h stability in canary with manual review.

Testing: unit tests for policy parsing and autorollback evaluator, integration tests against fake metrics backend, e2e tests in perf-canary harness that simulate slow CPU and transient error bursts. CI runs include full e2e on the rollout simulator.

Files of note and guidance: see files_changed for config snippets and sample rollout policies. Operators: use the new dashboard template (redwood-console > Rollouts > Enhanced autorollback) and set strategy-specific windows when migrating complex policies.

review_comments: Ethan Gomez: Can we avoid evaluating shadow traffic in the composite score by default? Suggest adding opt-in flag per rollout for shadow_contributes_to_score.
Aisha Patel (author): Good point - added shadow_contributes_to_score with default false in policy.go and updated docs.
Marta Novak: lgtm overall. One nit: the oscillation detector threshold is a bit aggressive (1 rollback in 10m). Can we make it configurable and bump to 1 in 5m for now?
Aisha Patel (author): Made cooldown configurable (CooldownWindow) and set default to 5m. Updated tests to reflect the change.
Victor Chen: Observability: please add a tag with rollout_id and strategy so traces are queryable by strategy. Also include the metric window used in the trace payload.
Aisha Patel (author): Added tags rollout_id and strategy, and included metric_window in trace payload. Updated dashboard template accordingly.

release_notes: Enhancement: improved autorollback safety and observability for unified rollouts. Add per-strategy metric windows and composite rollback scoring. Default behavior unchanged behind feature flag rollout.autorollback.enhanced.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated. To enable in staging: set rollout.autorollback.enhanced=true in feature flags and apply sample policy in docs/platform/rollouts.md. Monitor rollout_composite_score and rollback_count. If you see oscillation, adjust Policy.CooldownWindow or disable shadow_contributes_to_score for the rollout.
testing_performed: unit tests, integration tests against fake metrics backend, e2e simulated scenarios in perf-canary. Manual validation of Console dashboard and trace links. Staging soak for 48h in canary region before broader rollout.
